description:
FILED s543d (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21), member 3 of PPI batch 10 (#937).

perl-tests/sprintf2.t is NOT valid perl at lines 741-752, and the cause is PCL's own old edit of the file, not PPI.  `diff t/op/sprintf2.t perl-tests/sprintf2.t` (perl 5.40.3's own copy) shows three hunks where the hex-float assertions were commented out with "PCL: PPI cannot parse hex float literals" (lines 746-749, 758-765, 854-879).  The first hunk leaves a block whose ONLY content is comments:

    {
        # The 0x0.b17217f7d1cf78p0 is the original LHS value
        ...
        # is(sprintf("%a", 0x0.b17217f7d1cf78p0 - 0x1.62e42fefa39efp-1), ...
    }

    {
        no warnings 'overflow';  # Not the point here.

perl reads an empty / comment-only `{ }` at a statement start as an ANONYMOUS HASH (toke.c yyl_leftcurly: a `}` right after the `{`, comments skipped, is HASHBRACK), so the `{` on the next line is a syntax error -- probed: lines 734-790 extracted, with stub `skip` / `is`, die "syntax error at ... near "{"" under perl; `perl -e '{} print 1'` is the same error.  PPI reads it the same way (a Constructor), which is why the drop census row `perl-tests/sprintf2.t 1 Bug. Fell through. Missing case: ['Structure::Constructor<{ ...` exists and why #937 looked like a PPI bug.

The reason for the edit is gone: hex float literals are one Number::Float on PCL's PPI since s527a (group I, docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §2).

FIX (a harness change, perl-tests/*.t -- the WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN row "harness": full sweep + the census row leaves BY EDIT): restore perl's original lines in the three hunks (the file then matches t/op/sprintf2.t there), measure the restored rows (about 30 `is(sprintf("%a" / "%.1a" ...))` rows; some may fail on PCL's %a formatting -- each is then a row of its own cause), and edit baselines/parse-error-drop-census-s399.tsv (the sprintf2.t row) and baselines/fail-baseline.tsv / pass-baseline.tsv row by row.  Not done in s543d: a perl-tests edit is outside a PPI batch's scope.
subject: perl-tests/sprintf2.t lines 741-752 are INVALID perl because of PCL's old hex-float edit (a comment-only block, then a block: perl's own syntax error) -- the census drop #937 was blamed on PPI; restore perl's lines now that hex floats lex (§2)
triage_reason: a test-file edit of PCL's own made the file invalid perl; restoring it re-runs ~30 real rows of an IN area (sprintf)
